Render TeX in a plotly graph using MathJax

Source: R/mathjax.R
TeX.Rd

This function makes it slightly easier to render TeX in a plotly graph – it ensures the provided string is surrounded with $ (this is what plotly.js uses to declare a string as TeX). A figure with TeX includes MathJax (plotly.core's copy) when it's drawn; config(p, mathjax = "cdn") loads it from a CDN instead. save_image() needs nothing.

Usage

TeX(x)

Arguments

x

a character vector

Value

x, surrounded with $.

See also

config

Author

Carson Sievert

Examples

go_figure() |>
  update_layout(title = TeX("\\text{Some mathjax: }\\alpha+\\beta x")) |>
  config(mathjax = "cdn")
